name: NieR Gestalt ver.1.22474487139...
summary: NieR Gestalt ver.1.22474487139... is a fan-made overhaul for NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... that recreates the experience of the original Western release, NieR Gestalt. It replaces Brother Nier with the older Father Nier throughout the prologue and both parts of the story, including gameplay models, cutscenes, Dark Phantasm forms, the Shadowlord, and several alternate outfits. The mod also restores and adapts dialogue text, voice audio, music, pre-rendered movies, menus, and other presentation elements from the 2010 release, alongside various model improvements and optional add-ons designed to provide a more complete Gestalt-style playthrough.
